quotes.author: Adrian
quotes.text: Everything about this experience was excellent. I am from California and flew in to Utah for a week long vacation, and this was the absolute highlight of the trip. Communication was excellent- I spoke with multiple staff members over the phone prior to the trip and they answered all questions and gave me sufficient information to be prepared for the experience. On the day, our guide Chris took us out. He was experienced, passionate about fishing, friendly and very easy going. He was a good teacher, and explained everything very clearly

quotes.author: Julia
quotes.text: Our morning ice fishing with Chris and Brandon was epic!!! You know it’s been amazing when our 11yr old grandson wants to move here to ice fish! Chris was awesome with Landon 11 and Luke 7. Both boys caught trout with Chris! Thrilled! Brandon set up and took his time showing my daughter and I all the details of the sport! Excellent teacher and very personable! We all agree THIS was our favorite activity for this trip!! Thank you Jeff for being so accommodating and setting us up with the BEST guides ever! 🌸

quotes.author: Mark
quotes.text: First time ice fisher and Jeff and Chris of Utah Ice Fishing took great care of us. They were professional and fun with a real focus on helping us learn the techniques to catch fish. They even reached out prior to our trip and offered to adjust the start time of the trip to the optimal times they were experiencing the very best fishing. We caught a lot of fish (rainbows and cutthroats) and it was incredible. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them or go again! Top notch people and guide service.

quotes.author: Anita
quotes.text: This was such an amazing experience. We were first timers and Chris made our day perfect. From his funny and witty demeanor to his passionate knowledge of fishing made for the most enjoyable outing on a brisk 4 degree day. His set up of the warming tent was clutch and constant moving to many areas of the lake made us the stars of the anglers. We caught more than anyone out there! This was to celebrate my sons birthday and it couldn’t have been better. We will be back for sure!

quotes.author: Amy
quotes.text: Ice fishing was always a dream of our family. We contacted Utah Ice Fishing they more than made our dreams come true. They were super helpful in setting everything up for our arrival. Once we arrived Chris and Zach were our guides - the most amazing guides we could ask for. They were both so friendly and made my children’s experience one they will never forget. The personal attention they gave was more than ever expected. Thank you again.
